newsitem.title: UK: Shield Diagnostics to present AFT update.
newsitem.headline: Shield Diagnostics to present AFT update.

text.p: Scottish-based Shield Diagnostics Plc said on Friday that it would present an update on research linked to its lead product, a test for possible heart disease, on March 24.
In a statement, the company said it would make presentations to analysts on data related to Activated Factor Twelve (AFT), which the company believes is a crucial indicator of likely heart problems.
The company is developing a diagnostic test for AFT.
The company, which signed an agreement with U.S. diagnostics giant Abbott Laboratories Inc last month, believes AFT is a much more accurate predictor of heart attacks than cholesterol testing.

The company has been waiting for publication of two data from separate, independent trials on the link between AFT and heart attacks, one conducted in Britain and one in the U.S. It said last month that initial analysis of the British study appeared to confirm the link.
Shares in Shield have soared in recent months on expectations of positive news. They were down 3 1/2 pence at 610 pence in midmorning trade on Friday.
